integrity: Analytical proof with standalone exact finite identity checks; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only two specified evaluation locations are evaluated; the global projector norm and its maximizers are not determined.

title: Vertex–centroid positivity-loss separation for quadratic simplex projection
